comments.zh: Fluent 对级登记 + 特性侧 [MapSubclass] 多实例；isinst 分派链（Map/MapList/_Update 双实例）
comments.en: Fluent-side class-level registration + attribute-side [MapSubclass] multi-instance registration; isinst dispatch chain (dual instances for Map/MapList/_Update)

comments.zh: + 最派生优先 + 未登记派生回落基类兜底体 + 反向子类对自动产出（登记非单向）。
comments.en: + Most-derived-type-first dispatch + unregistered derived types fall back to base-class default implementation + reverse subclass mappings are automatically generated (registration is bidirectional, not unidirectional).

comments.zh: Fluent 侧基类对映射——运行时按源实际类型路由子类分派体。
comments.en: Fluent-side base-class mapping—runtime dispatch to subclass-specific implementations based on the actual source type.

comments.zh: <param name="src">动物实体（可能是任一派生类型）</param>
comments.en: <param name="src">Animal entity (potentially any derived type)</param>

comments.zh: <returns>基类静态类型的 DTO（运行时实际为对应子类 DTO）</returns>
comments.en: <returns>DTO of static base-class type (at runtime, actually the corresponding subclass DTO)</returns>

comments.zh: Fluent 侧 _Update 形态——双实例匹配（src 与 dst 同时 isinst 命中才路由子类体）。
comments.en: Fluent-side _Update form—dual-instance matching (subclasses are dispatched only when both src and dst pass isinst checks).

comments.zh: <param name="src">源实体</param>
comments.en: <param name="src">Source entity</param>

comments.zh: <param name="existing">既有 DTO（运行时类型决定分派）</param>
comments.en: <param name="existing">Existing DTO (dispatch determined by its runtime type)</param>

comments.zh: 特性侧映射——类级 [MapSubclass] 多实例登记的分派。
comments.en: Attribute-side mapping—class-level [MapSubclass] multi-instance registration dispatch.

comments.zh: <param name="src">动物实体</param>
comments.en: <param name="src">Animal entity</param>

comments.zh: <returns>特性侧基类 DTO（运行时对应子类）</returns>
comments.en: <returns>Attribute-side base-class DTO (corresponding to the runtime subclass at execution time)</returns>

comments.zh: 场景调度 — 顺序执行全部子场景并输出。
comments.en: Scenario orchestration—execute all sub-scenarios sequentially and output results.

comments.zh: 1. Fluent Map dispatch: Dog -> DogDto (subclass body, dedicated fields filled)
comments.en: 1. Fluent Map dispatch: Dog → DogDto (subclass-specific implementation, populating subclass-specific fields)

comments.zh: 2. Fluent Map dispatch: Cat -> CatDto
comments.en: 2. Fluent Map dispatch: Cat → CatDto

comments.zh: 3. Unregistered derived type falls back to the base catch-all body: Bird goes through the AnimalDto base body (subclass-dedicated fields have no source)
comments.en: 3. Unregistered derived type fallback: Bird uses AnimalDto base-class implementation (subclass-specific fields lack source data)

comments.zh: 4. MapList mixed list: per-element dispatch by runtime type + fallback
comments.en: 4. MapList heterogeneous list: per-element dispatch based on runtime type + fallback

comments.zh: 5. _Update dual-instance match: dst runtime type DogDto -- route to subclass body; dst runtime type base class -- fall back to base body (F50 dual-instance-fallback)
comments.en: 5. _Update dual-instance matching: dst runtime type DogDto → routes to subclass implementation; dst runtime type base class → falls back to base-class implementation (F50 dual-instance-fallback)

comments.zh: 6. Reverse subclass pair (registration is not one-way; the reverse registration arm is produced automatically): DogDto -> DogEntity
comments.en: 6. Reverse subclass mappings (registration is bidirectional, not unidirectional; reverse registration arms are auto-generated): DogDto → DogEntity

comments.zh: 7. 特性侧 [MapSubclass]：类级多实例登记，分派语义与 Fluent 等价
comments.en: 7. Attribute-side [MapSubclass]: class-level multi-instance registration; dispatch semantics equivalent to Fluent
